steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Wretched thing.

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Boss, what are we gonna do?

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: I think we better fall back.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Fall back? We haven't lost yet.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: We already wiped out the guardsmen, we just need to wait for the right time to counterattack.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: A couple Rhodes Island mercs are no big deal.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Where's my egghead?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Where's anybody?

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: What's that smell?

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: What happened to the guys we had watching him?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Looks like you're in a tough spot, my friend.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Let me guess, even with my mighty Originium creations, you still failed.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: To be honest, I'm not the least bit surprised.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: I don't have time for your sarcasm.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Well, knowing what I know of you, you're here to ask me for new toys... No wonder your father doesn't like you.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Enough bullshit, I need...

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Are you talking to me, sir?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Because I think you forgot the magic word.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: You're asking for my help. Was that the proper attitude?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Are you screwing with me...?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Do I look like I'm joking?

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Oh, this old geezer needs a beating!

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Aaaahh!

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: What is this?! What is this?!

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: My head! My head's... gonna explode... it's...

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: You! What have you done?!

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: You apes really have nothing of value beyond your brute strength.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: And you, sir, do you really think you can keep science locked up in here with this bunch of mentally deficient clods?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Go, and tell our grand old sponsor to settle down.

steps.name: Originiutant Infected
steps.text: Gaa...

steps.name: Originiutant Infected
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What the hell are those...??

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: You can't tell? They're your men.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Of course, they've become so much more now. Much more obedient.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: And soon, you'll be just like them.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: Why can you control them? You know no Originium Arts!

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Only Originium Arts can control them? You people are so blinkered.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Have you ever thought about why 'Originium Arts' can control those 'infected creatures'?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Of course, you, with your tiny brain, can never figure it out.

a.text: The mad scientist rolls up a sleeve.
A swollen Originium lump is twitching under his arm.
As if it were alive, having its own mind.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: As long as you become a part of them, naturally you can communicate with them. We are having a good time together.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: You're such a hopeless lunatic...

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: I'm a member of the House of Tulla! I'm the successor to the Elder bloodline of the Tulla family.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: It's a death sentence to murder a noble on land that belongs to the Lord Ameer of Bayalir.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Lord Ameer? Noble? Bloodline?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Ahahahahaha...

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: You amuse me, Mr. Drudge.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: But I'm tired of this joke.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: 'I do not hate the pig, I hate only the golden crown that hangs above.'

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: In my homeland, the cardinals were burned, kings were hanged, emperors beheaded, every vestige of the old order smashed to pieces to ensure none would ever again fear the so-called 'nobility.'

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: What Lord Ameer? What bloodline?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: You are nothing to me.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: The stinking sack of meat that is your body is even less useful than those of the Oripathy sufferers.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: What do you call them again?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Oh yes, the Infected.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: The Infected have contributed to my experiments. But what have you done?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Your status has no value to me. And your lack of foresight is baffling.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Useless trash.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Such a vile, stupid, evil thing still calls itself 'noble'?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Tell me, what part of you is noble?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Anyway, you have nothing to worry about. I have no interest in your rotten worldview... I am a scientist. I pursue only objective truth.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Science treats all people equally. It won't change a bit because of your background.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Nobles and commoners are the same, on the operating table. The scalpel cuts skin just as well. Your contribution is identical.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Considering you specifically, once you donate your body to science, you will no doubt be slightly more noble than you are now.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: You should feel honored.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: You despicable traitor!

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Traitor? Traitor?

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Ahahahahaha...

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: You raised your hand against your very own sister. You betrayed your flesh and blood. You colluded with foreign mercenaries to plunder your father's wealth. You betrayed the country that birthed and raised you.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: And you still have the gall to call me traitor?

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: You won't get away. You have no idea what the forces behind me are doing.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: They're the ones who came up with all your research funding for the last six months. If you betray me now, you're betraying them too.

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: The people of Volvort Kochinski will hunt you to the ends of the world. They will kill you!

steps.name: Drudge
steps.text: There's nowhere you can run.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: That, I will handle. Don't you worry.

steps.name: Levi
steps.text: Goodbye, imbecile.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: What's with the getup?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I found it in the Lord's storehouse. It looks good.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: ...Yeah, it sure does.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: This is the craziest battle plan I've ever heard.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Very convincing.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: How do you know an Originium explosion will draw the monsters out of the ground?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: All I can say is it's thanks to the doctor.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: The monsters have been obeying the casters all this time, except that one night. I realized those wild monsters were actually chasing the scattered Originium shards.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: So you decided this is the way to go?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's kind of a gamble, actually.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Where did you get this Originium engine?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: ...Well... some things happened, and, I guess, we ended up with a car.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...it looks awfully familiar.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...isn't it the one we lost?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Let's not worry about that now. Hah.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: What about the mine?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: That mercenary we caught basically gave out everything. The factory your brother used to produce monsters is located deep inside the mine. I even think he probably hasn't given up yet.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Ah... That makes sense.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If we bait the monsters out here, Cohen will have a chance to bring her people down there and blow the *profanity* thing up.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Just as simple as that.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Doesn't sound simple though...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: This plan seems to be full of the unexpected and far from seamless.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: But I like this kind of plan, where battling is the only solution.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If even Rangers says so...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: All right, friends. Take your places.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If all goes according to plan, firing up the Originium engine will get a whole bunch of monsters coming at us.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: And we're in for a tough fight.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: And thank you, Rhodes Islanders... for choosing to stay and help.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't worry about it. It's my job to clear out contaminated wildlife.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Is that unpaid work?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're so annoying!

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: ...Thank you... I don't know how to express my gratitude...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Let's save the thanks for later.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Alright. If there are no further questions...

a.text: The Originium engine chugs out a steady sound, with thick smoke rising up and flames lighting up the sky.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Here they come...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Too many?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: How many? Over a hundred?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: No, probably more...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: No... there are even more coming.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: We can only hope Cohen is doing okay.
